/* ===== Google Translate: keep visible + clickable ===== */
#google_translate_element{
  position: relative;
  z-index: 99999 !important;
  text-align: right;
  padding: 6px 0;
}

/* DO NOT hide iframes globally. It breaks the menu. */
/* Remove/avoid: body > .skiptranslate > iframe.skiptranslate {display:none} */

/* Style the dropdown */
#google_translate_element .goog-te-gadget{
  font-family: Ubuntu, Arial, sans-serif;
  font-size: 0; /* hide extra text around dropdown */
}

#google_translate_element .goog-te-gadget-simple{
  font-size: 14px;
  background: var(--spa-accent);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 6px 10px;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.12);
}

#google_translate_element .goog-te-gadget-simple span{
  color: #fff !important;
}

/* Fix: dropdown iframe sometimes appears behind header */
.goog-te-menu-frame{
  z-index: 999999 !important;
}

/* Fix: Google sometimes pushes page down */
body{ top: 0 !important; }
.goog-te-banner-frame{ display:none !important; } /* hides top bar only */

  background-image:

    linear-gradient(-25deg, transparent 30%, #F8F8F8, transparent 35%),
    linear-gradient(25deg, transparent 30%, #F8F8F8, transparent 35%),
    linear-gradient(65deg, transparent 65%, #F8F8F8, transparent 70%),
    linear-gradient(-65deg, transparent 65%, #F8F8F8, transparent 70%),
    linear-gradient(-65deg, transparent 30%, #F8F8F8, transparent 35%),

  text-decoration:none !important;
  text-align:center;
  color:#1f2937;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.86);
 /* border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.08);*/

  box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);

  height: 110px;
  margin: 0 auto 10px;
  display:flex;

}

        /* ===== SPAB Modern About + Highlights ===== */
:root{
  --spa-accent:#1AA6A8;
  --sp-dark:#1f2937;
  --sp-muted:#6b7280;
  --sp-border:#e7edf5;
  --sp-bg:#f6f9fe;
  --sp-card:#ffffff;
}

.sp-section{
  background: #fff;
  padding: 38px 0;
}

.sp-section .sp-wrap{
    max-width: 90%;    

}

.sp-wrap{
  max-width: 1220px;                 /* content center */
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0 16px;
  position: relative;                /* above overlay */
  z-index: 2;
}

.sp-kicker{
  color: var(--spa-accent2);
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: .04em;
  font-size: 20px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.sp-title{
   color: #666;
   font-weight: 800;
   font-size: 18px;
   line-height: 1.1;
   margin: 10px 0 14px;
}

.sp-lead{
  color: var(--sp-dark);
  font-size: 15.5px;
  line-height: 1.8;
  margin: 0 0 16px;
}

.sp-pill-actions{
  display:flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 10px;
  margin: 16px 0 18px;
}

.sp-pill{
  display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 10px;
  min-width: 240px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  border: 1px solid var(--sp-border);
  border-radius: 12px;
  color:#111827;
  background:#f7f9ff;
  text-decoration:none !important;
  font-weight: 600;
  transition: transform .15s ease, box-shadow .15s ease, border-color .15s ease;
}

.sp-pill i{
  color: var(--spa-accent);
  font-size: 14px;
}

.sp-pill:hover{
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  border-color:#d7e1f2;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 22px rgba(16,24,40,.08);
  color:#111827;
}

.sp-mini-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0,1fr));
  gap: 14px;
  margin-top: 10px;
}

.sp-mini-card{
  background: var(--sp-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--sp-border);
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 16px;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 18px rgba(16,24,40,.06);
  height: 100%;
}

.sp-mini-card h5{
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 800;
  margin: 0 0 10px;
  color:#111827;
}

.sp-mini-card ul{
  padding-left: 18px;
  margin: 0 0 10px;
  color: var(--sp-dark);
}

.sp-mini-card li{
  margin-bottom: 8px;
  line-height: 1.65;
  font-size: 14px;
}

.sp-mini-link{
  color: var(--spa-accent) !important;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-decoration:none !important;
}

.sp-side-card{
  background: var(--sp-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--sp-border);
  border-radius: 18px;
  box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(16,24,40,.10);
  overflow:hidden;
  height: 100%;
}

.sp-side-head{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 18px 18px 12px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--sp-border);
}

.sp-side-badge{
  width: 42px;
  height: 42px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: rgba(158,42,43,.10);
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;
  color: var(--spa-accent);
  font-size: 18px;
}

.sp-side-head h5{
  margin:0;
  font-weight: 800;
  color:#111827;
}

.sp-side-head p{
  margin:2px 0 0;

.sp-side-body{
  padding: 14px 18px 18px;
}

 <script>
     (function () {
         function Ticker1(elementId) {
             this.el = document.getElementById(elementId);
             if (!this.el) return;

             this.wrapper = document.getElementById("ticker1-wrapper-inner");
             this.items = Array.prototype.slice.call(this.wrapper.querySelectorAll("li"));

             // remove empty li if any
             this.items = this.items.filter(function (li) { return li.innerText.trim().length > 0; });

             this.totalItems = this.items.length;
             this.timer = null;
             this.index = 0;

             this.setOffsets();
             this.start();
             this.bindHover();
             window.addEventListener("resize", this.onResize.bind(this));
         }

         Ticker1.prototype.setOffsets = function () {
             var top = 0;
             for (var i = 0; i < this.totalItems; i++) {
                 this.items[i].setAttribute("data-top", top);
                 top += this.items[i].offsetHeight;
             }
         };

         Ticker1.prototype.start = function () {
             var self = this;
             if (self.timer) clearInterval(self.timer);

             self.timer = setInterval(function () {
                 self.index = (self.index + 1) % self.totalItems;
                 var item = self.items[self.index];
                 var top = parseInt(item.getAttribute("data-top") || "0", 10);
                 self.wrapper.style.transform = "translateY(-" + top + "px)";
             }, 3000);
         };

         Ticker1.prototype.bindHover = function () {
             var self = this;
             this.el.addEventListener("mouseenter", function () {
                 if (self.timer) clearInterval(self.timer);
                 self.timer = null;
             });
             this.el.addEventListener("mouseleave", function () {
                 self.start();
             });
         };

         Ticker1.prototype.onResize = function () {
             this.setOffsets();
             var item = this.items[this.index];
             var top = parseInt(item.getAttribute("data-top") || "0", 10);
             this.wrapper.style.transform = "translateY(-" + top + "px)";
         };

         document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
             new Ticker1("ticker1");
         });
     })();
 </script>

    <script>
        (function () {

            function handleSwipe() {
                var dx = endX - startX;
                var dy = endY - startY;

                // ignore mostly-vertical moves (scroll)
                if (Math.abs(dy) > maxVerticalMove) return;

                // only left/right swipe
                if (Math.abs(dx) < minSwipeDist) return;

                if (dx < 0) {
                    $("#spGalleryCarousel").carousel("next");
                } else {
                    $("#spGalleryCarousel").carousel("prev");
                }
            }

            // Touch events (mobile)
            $(document).on("touchstart", "#spGalleryModal .sp-lb-main", function (e) {
                if (!$("#spGalleryModal").hasClass("show")) return;

            $(document).on("touchmove", "#spGalleryModal .sp-lb-main", function (e) {
                if (!$("#spGalleryModal").hasClass("show")) return;

                var t = e.originalEvent.touches[0];
                endX = t.clientX; endY = t.clientY;
            });

            $(document).on("touchend", "#spGalleryModal .sp-lb-main", function () {
                if (!$("#spGalleryModal").hasClass("show")) return;

            // OPTIONAL: Mouse drag swipe (desktop)
            $(document).on("mousedown", "#spGalleryModal .sp-lb-main", function (e) {

                if (!isDown) return;
                isDown = false;
                handleSwipe();
            });
        })();
    </script>

    <script>

        (function () {
            function clamp(v, min, max) { return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, v)); }

            function resetSlide($slide) {
                $slide.data("spScale", 1);
                $slide.data("spTx", 0);
                $slide.data("spTy", 0);
                $slide.data("spPanning", false);
                $slide.find(".sp-zoom-img").css("transform", "translate(0px,0px) scale(1)");
            }

            function applyTransform($slide) {
                var s = $slide.data("spScale") || 1;
                var tx = $slide.data("spTx") || 0;
                var ty = $slide.data("spTy") || 0;
                $slide.find(".sp-zoom-img").css("transform", "translate(" + tx + "px," + ty + "px) scale(" + s + ")");
            }

            function activeSlide() {
                return $("#spGalleryCarousel .carousel-item.active");
            }

            // Reset on modal close + slide change
            $("#spGalleryModal").on("hidden.bs.modal", function () {
                $("#spGalleryCarousel .carousel-item").each(function () { resetSlide($(this)); });
            });

            $("#spGalleryCarousel").on("slide.bs.carousel", function () {
                // reset outgoing slide to avoid weird states
                $("#spGalleryCarousel .carousel-item").each(function () { resetSlide($(this)); });
            });

            // ---- Touch pinch + pan ----
            var pinch = {
                active: false,
                startDist: 0,
                startScale: 1,
                startMidX: 0,
                startMidY: 0,
                startTx: 0,
                startTy: 0,
                panActive: false,
                panStartX: 0,
                panStartY: 0
            };

            function dist(t1, t2) {
                var dx = t2.clientX - t1.clientX;
                var dy = t2.clientY - t1.clientY;
                return Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
            }

            function mid(t1, t2) {
                return { x: (t1.clientX + t2.clientX) / 2, y: (t1.clientY + t2.clientY) / 2 };
            }

            // Use the wrap so it works regardless of image sizes
            $(document).on("touchstart", "#spGalleryModal .sp-zoom-wrap", function (e) {
                if (!$("#spGalleryModal").hasClass("show")) return;

                var $slide = activeSlide();
                var touches = e.originalEvent.touches;

                // Two-finger pinch start
                if (touches.length === 2) {
                    pinch.active = true;
                    pinch.panActive = false;

                    pinch.startDist = dist(touches[0], touches[1]);
                    pinch.startScale = $slide.data("spScale") || 1;

                    var m = mid(touches[0], touches[1]);
                    pinch.startMidX = m.x;
                    pinch.startMidY = m.y;

                    pinch.startTx = $slide.data("spTx") || 0;
                    pinch.startTy = $slide.data("spTy") || 0;

                    // prevent page scroll
                    e.preventDefault();
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    return;
                }

                // One-finger pan start (only if zoomed)
                if (touches.length === 1) {
                    var s = $slide.data("spScale") || 1;
                    if (s > 1.01) {
                        pinch.panActive = true;
                        pinch.panStartX = touches[0].clientX;
                        pinch.panStartY = touches[0].clientY;
                        e.preventDefault();
                        e.stopPropagation();
                    }
                }
            });

            $(document).on("touchmove", "#spGalleryModal .sp-zoom-wrap", function (e) {
                if (!$("#spGalleryModal").hasClass("show")) return;

                var $slide = activeSlide();
                var touches = e.originalEvent.touches;

                // Pinch move
                if (pinch.active && touches.length === 2) {
                    var currentDist = dist(touches[0], touches[1]);
                    var ratio = currentDist / pinch.startDist;

                    var newScale = clamp(pinch.startScale * ratio, 1, 4); // max zoom 4x
                    $slide.data("spScale", newScale);

                    // Optional: slight translate so pinch feels anchored (simple approach)
                    var m = mid(touches[0], touches[1]);
                    var dx = (m.x - pinch.startMidX);
                    var dy = (m.y - pinch.startMidY);

                    // translate a bit when zoomed
                    var tx = pinch.startTx + dx * 0.6;
                    var ty = pinch.startTy + dy * 0.6;

                    // clamp pan range based on scale (simple clamp)
                    var limit = 220 * (newScale - 1);
                    $slide.data("spTx", clamp(tx, -limit, limit));
                    $slide.data("spTy", clamp(ty, -limit, limit));

                    applyTransform($slide);

                    e.preventDefault();
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    return;
                }

                // Pan move
                if (pinch.panActive && touches.length === 1) {
                    var s = $slide.data("spScale") || 1;
                    if (s <= 1.01) return;

                    var x = touches[0].clientX;
                    var y = touches[0].clientY;

                    var dx2 = x - pinch.panStartX;
                    var dy2 = y - pinch.panStartY;

                    pinch.panStartX = x;
                    pinch.panStartY = y;

                    var tx2 = ($slide.data("spTx") || 0) + dx2;
                    var ty2 = ($slide.data("spTy") || 0) + dy2;

                    var limit2 = 220 * (s - 1);
                    $slide.data("spTx", clamp(tx2, -limit2, limit2));
                    $slide.data("spTy", clamp(ty2, -limit2, limit2));

                    applyTransform($slide);

                    e.preventDefault();
                    e.stopPropagation();
                }
            });

            $(document).on("touchend touchcancel", "#spGalleryModal .sp-zoom-wrap", function (e) {
                var touches = (e.originalEvent.touches || []);
                if (touches.length < 2) pinch.active = false;
                if (touches.length === 0) pinch.panActive = false;
            });

            // ---- Double tap / double click toggle zoom ----
            var lastTap = 0;
            $(document).on("click", "#spGalleryModal .sp-zoom-wrap", function () {
                // desktop double click will also work via timing
                var now = Date.now();
                if (now - lastTap < 300) {
                    var $slide = activeSlide();
                    var s = $slide.data("spScale") || 1;
                    if (s > 1.01) {
                        resetSlide($slide);
                    } else {
                        $slide.data("spScale", 2);
                        $slide.data("spTx", 0);
                        $slide.data("spTy", 0);
                        applyTransform($slide);
                    }
                }
                lastTap = now;
            });

        })();
    </script>

            $(document).on('click', '.dropdown-submenu > .dropdown-toggle', function (e) {

                $(this).closest('.dropdown-menu').find('.dropdown-menu.show').not($submenu).removeClass('show');

            if (achievementCardsCache) return;

            achievementCardsCache = [];
            $('#achievementCarousel .carousel-item .col-md-4, #achievementCarousel .carousel-item .col-12').each(function () {
                achievementCardsCache.push($(this).clone());
            });
        }

        function buildAchievementCarousel() {
            cacheAchievementCards();

            var perSlide = getPerSlide();
            if (lastPerSlide === perSlide) {
                fixAchievementCarouselHeight();
                return;
            }

            lastPerSlide = perSlide;

            var $inner = $('#achievementCarousel .carousel-inner');
            $inner.empty();

            for (var i = 0; i < achievementCardsCache.length; i += perSlide) {
                var $item = $('<div class="carousel-item"></div>');
                var $row = $('<div class="row"></div>');

                for (var j = i; j < i + perSlide && j < achievementCardsCache.length; j++) {
                    var $cardCol = achievementCardsCache[j].clone();

                    if (perSlide === 1) {
                        $cardCol.removeClass('col-md-4').addClass('col-12');
                    } else {
                        $cardCol.removeClass('col-12').addClass('col-md-4');
                    }

                    $row.append($cardCol);
                }

                $item.append($row);
                $inner.append($item);
            }

            $inner.find('.carousel-item').first().addClass('active');

            $('#achievementCarousel').carousel(0);
            fixAchievementCarouselHeight();
        }

        function fixAchievementCarouselHeight() {
            var maxHeight = 0;

            $('#achievementCarousel .carousel-inner').css('height', 'auto');
            $('#achievementCarousel .carousel-item').css('min-height', 'auto');

            $('#achievementCarousel .carousel-item').each(function () {
                var h = $(this).outerHeight(true);
                if (h > maxHeight) {
                    maxHeight = h;
                }
            });

            $('#achievementCarousel .carousel-inner').css('height', maxHeight + 'px');
        }

        $(window).on('load', function () {
            buildAchievementCarousel();
        });

        $(window).on('resize', function () {
            buildAchievementCarousel();
        });

        $('#achievementCarousel').on('slid.bs.carousel', function () {
            fixAchievementCarouselHeight();
        });
    })();
